message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm in the kitchen when my kids decided it was the perfect time to have a spontaneous dance party. With all the noise, I almost forgot to check on my simmering sauce—thankfully, I caught it just in time! It got me thinking about how important it is to have a fire escape plan that includes everyone, even the little ones who can get a bit distracted. Have you ever had a moment where you had to juggle safety and fun? How do you keep your family fire-safe while still enjoying life?
